RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 4, 2002/Agrahayana 13, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Coal and Mines; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional
Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—20
67
Induction of AJT in Defence
*221. SHRI S. AGNIRAJ: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) what steps are being taken to induct
AJT in Indian Air Force;
(b) what is the reason for delay;
(c) when it is likely to be inducted; and
(d) whether financial constraints are
prohibiting the implementation and if so,
the details thereof?
Terrorist activities from Bhutan
*222. SHRI SURESH KALMADI:
SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that the militants are carrying on
terrorist activities on a large scale from
Bhutan alongwith the Assam-Bhutan
border;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken/proposed to be taken in this regard;
(c) whether the Central Government
have received any request from the State
Government of Assam to flush out National
Democratic Front for Bodoland (N.D.F.B.)
militants; if so, the details thereof; and
(d) Government's reaction thereto and
steps contemplated in this direction?
Jai Prakash Rozgar Guarantee
Yojana
*223. SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether a Rs. 5,000 crore
employment guarantee scheme known as
Jai Prakash Rozgar Guarantee Yojana, in
130 most-backward districts of the country,
will be launched this year;
(b) if so, the details of the scheme;
(c) whether a task force was set up by
Government for selection of the districts to
be included in the said scheme;
(d) if so, what are the names of the
districts selected; and
(e) by when the work on this scheme is
likely to be started?
Deportation of Abu Salem to India
*224. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY :
DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the underworld don,

Lisbon;
(b) if so, whether a CBI team has been

Abu Salem to India?
Rehabilitation package for riot
victims in Gujarat
*225. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
prepared a rehabilitation package for riot
affected people of Gujarat;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reasons for delay in finalising the
package?
Insurance schemes for handloom
weavers in Andhra Pradesh
*226. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether insurance schemes have
been extended to the handloom weavers of
Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the number of weavers
covered under the schemes as on date,
district-wise;
(c) the details of the terms and conditions
of the schemes; and
(d) the role being played by Central and
State Governments in this regard?
Cooperation of State Governments in
NCC activities
*227. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Governments are not cooperating in the
National Cadet Corps (NCC) activities in
their States causing great difficulty to the
NCC;
(b) if so, the States which are not
cooperating; and
(c) the steps being taken by Government
to ensure cooperation and help of all States
in activities of NCC?
Assistance to S.E.R.Cs
*228. SHRI S.M. LAL JAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have a plan to
assist the State Electricity Regulatory
Commission, based on their performance;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether money has been released to
any State Electricity Regulatory
Commission under this incentive scheme;
and
(d) if so, the details of funds released?
Aircraft crashes
*229. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the recent
accidents of Air Force aircrafts, MIG,
Jaguar, etc. and the mid-air collision of two
Russian-made long-range IL-38 maritime
reconnaissance aircrafts at Goa, present a

very disturbing scenario of our defence
preparedness; and
(b) if so, the reasons for this state of
affairs and what is the gist of the
recommendations of the various Enquiry
Committees set up relating to Defence aircraft
accidents during the last three years?
Pensionary benefits to CISF
personnel
*230. SHRI DARA SINGH
CHAUHAN: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the number of CISF personnel posted at
PTPP, Parichcha, Jhansi (UP) are not
getting pensionary benefits since 1990 even
after completion of more than 20 years
service due to some minor mistakes;
(b) if so, the category-wise details
thereof;
(c) whether Director-General of CISF
have received any representations from the
Member of Parliament in the February, May,
2001 and January, 2002 in this regard; and
(d) if so, the action taken/proposed to be
taken in this regard?
Massacre at Kokrajhar district of
Assam
*231. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the recent massacre of 22 persons in
Kokrajhar district of Assam on Indo-Bhutan
border;
(b) if so, the details of action Government
propose to take for avoiding such massacre
in future;
(c) whether Chief Minister of Assam
requested for additional para-military forces
to be deployed in Assam for tackling the
law and order situation; and
(d) if so, the details indicating the
number of para-military forces deployed in
Assam?
Constitution of Central Negotiating
Division for hostage situations
*232. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to constitute a Central  Negotiating
Division to tackle hostage situations instead
of commando operation;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the details of any groundwork
done by the Central Government in this
direction?
Sampoorna Gramin Rozgar
Yojana
*233. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the quantity of wheat
sought and released so far to various States
under Sampoorna Gramin Rozgar Yojana
(SGRY) after start of relief operations during
the current year;
(b) the reasons for delay in release of
wheat even after clearance by the task force
formed for the purpose; and
(c) the details of the steps taken by
Government to lessen the time taken in
completing official formalities for release
of foodgrains under the SGRY?

Misuse of rice under Food for Work
Programme
*234. SHRI R.P. GOENKA:
SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU):
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that recently some
representations have been received by his
Ministry detailing cases of misuse of a major
chunk of over 31.5 lakh tonnes of rice worth
Rs. 3,600 crore released by the Central
Government, free of cost, under the Food
for Work Programme to Andhra Pradesh;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken/proposed to be taken thereon?
Computerization in MCD
*235. SHRI  B.J. PANDA:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Municipal Corporation of
Delhi plans computerization to control graft;
if so, the details of this project;
(b) whether the MCD has been working
on the same lines as that of DDA; and
(c) the proposed measures for
revamping the entire system and to make it
customer-friendly?
Extension of Accelerated Generation
and Supply Programme
*236. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Union Government's
proposal to extend the Accelerated
Generation and Supply Programme till 2007
has since been approved;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the schemes of Ninth Five
Year Plan relating to increasing of power
generation capacity and modernization of
transmission links would also be extended
with some modifications; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Bio-gas plants financed by
Government
*237. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of NON-
CONVENTIONAL ENERGY SOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise details of the bio-gas
plants, financed by Government, since
January, 2001;
(b) the details of the subsidies extended
to the companies and State Governments
for setting up these plants, particularly in
Tamil Nadu; and
(c) the details of the repayment made by
these companies, State Governments
and action taken on companies which have
not repaid the loan amount since
January, 2001?

MURTHY: Will the Minister of COAL
AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) how many employees of Bharat
Gold Mines Limited, KGF who lost their
jobs due to closure of the above organisation;
(b) whether Government have taken
steps to rehabilitate those who lost their jobs;
and

Will the Minister of RURAL

Constitution of SERC in Kerala

POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of Kerala
has constituted the Tariff Regulatory

with the non-constitution of Tariff
Regulatory Commission;
(c) if so, the details thereof;

extend the Central assistance due to Kerala;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
